parameters.query:
SELECT id, tenant_id, config->>'spreadsheet_id' AS spreadsheet_id, coalesce(config->>'sheet', '') AS sheet
FROM data_sources
WHERE is_active AND source_type = 'google_sheets' AND coalesce(config->>'spreadsheet_id', '') <> ''
  AND (last_synced_at IS NULL OR last_synced_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => greatest(sync_interval_min - 1, 1)));
